Build and install a package

Create a manifest, package your source and enable it in BYgram.

Package layout

A .byplugin contains manifest.json and a Python entry module such as main.py. Use a dotted identifier, a numeric three-component version and an entrypoint in path.py:ClassName form.

See the manifest reference for SDK bounds, capabilities and account scope.

Build and install

Open the package through Settings → BYgram settings → Plugins → Install from file. Review the manifest, enable the engine and approve execution for the package. Grant only the accounts the plugin needs.
